svg.title: Loom and Granite: a concentrated beam blooming into a spectrum
svg.desc: A thin white beam labelled Loom and Granite, built solo, travels into a prism labelled Apple, Inc. and blooms into seven colored rays: AI safety, social app safety, iOS architecture, on-device ML, core research, Rao Studios and 2026 Year in Review.
